    <h1>Spectral flow and the chiral anomaly in 1+1</h1>
    <p class="course-toc-meta">Topic: Symmetries and Noether&#x27;s theorem</p>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
**Goal:** Understand the origin of the chiral anomaly as a geometric effect related to the spectral flow of energy levels.

1.  Consider the massless Dirac equation in 1+1, $$i\gamma^\mu(\partial_\mu+ieA_\mu)\psi=0,$$ on a ring of length $L$.

2.  Impose periodic boundary conditions and find the energy spectrum $E_n(A_1)$.

3.  Change $A_1(t)$ slowly from $0$ to $$\Delta A_1=\frac{2\pi}{eL}.$$

4.  Plot the evolution of the energy levels and show that the levels cross zero.

5.  Show that the numbers of right- and left-handed states change, even though the chiral current is formally conserved.

6.  Discuss why this cannot be explained without taking the vacuum into account, even in a single-particle setting.

:::
